external_collaboration.evidence_quote: The Professional Bachelor’s study programme in Finance Management Information Systems (FinTech),* offered jointly by Riga Technical University (RTU) and the University of Latvia (LU) is designed for tech-savvy problem solvers who want to master the code behind money and build the next generation of banking, crypto, and secure digital payments.

At the heart of digital transformation, FinTech represents the intersection where finance meets IT to revolutionise how the world moves money. In addition to earning a joint diploma, graduates gain the official professional qualification of certified Programming Engineer. The programme also provides global certification: completing the “Financial Management” course earns students a Professional Certificate from the Scottish Qualifications Agency (SQA) for an immediate edge in international marke
RTU has implemented the online payment gateway platform, Flywire, which offers easy and trustworthy payment options

Moving beyond a standard degree, the programme offers exclusive professional certification: students complete a networking course to earn the internationally recognised MikroTik Certified Network Associate (MTCNA) certificate during their studies.
